title: Law to require sidewalk-detection tech on shared e-bikes and scooters
summary: This bill would require companies that run bike-share and scooter-share systems to install sidewalk riding detection technology, such as GPS, cameras or sensors, on each shared e-bike and e-scooter. Those devices would also need a safety feature that gradually slows and stops a vehicle detected riding on a sidewalk. A first violation would carry no fine, but later violations within two years could bring a civil penalty of up to $1,000, and the law would take effect one year after passage.
